author: Engineezy
description:
I Built a Camera Rig That Drops the Camera 📱
•••
CASETiFY wanted me to test their  Ultra Impact cases for the iPhone 18 Pro series, which gave me an idea: what could I film while the camera itself was falling? I designed and 3D printed a release mechanism to drop objects alongside a recording phone. The challenge was releasing everything together while keeping the subject in frame, all while putting the case's drop protection to the test.. When it works, the objects look like they’re floating while the entire workshop moves around them. The phone survived every drop
•••
